context: A dad and his young son plan a sightseeing day
purpose: Teach: 国道/トンネル/タワー/ナイト/ムード/西部/入居/市販

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: パパ、今日はどこに行くの？東京タワーに登りたい！
lines.en: Dad, where are we going today? I want to climb Tokyo Tower!
lines.style: Excited child voice, high energy, eager and bouncy delivery

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: いいね。じゃあタワーに登ってから、国道沿いの食堂でお昼にしようか。パパが子供の頃から好きな店なんだ。
lines.en: Sounds good. Then after the tower, let's have lunch at a diner along the national highway. It's a place I've loved since I was a kid.
lines.style: Warm fatherly tone, relaxed and nostalgic, gentle smile in voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やった！長いトンネルも通る？トンネルの中、ちょっと怖いけど好き！
lines.en: Yay! Will we go through a long tunnel too? Tunnels are a little scary but I like them!
lines.style: Childlike enthusiasm mixed with playful nervousness, sing-song delivery

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 通るよ。そのあと、新しくできたビルに入居した水族館にも行こう。東京の西部のほうにあるんだ。
lines.en: We'll go through one. After that, let's visit the aquarium that moved into a brand-new building. It's over in the western part of Tokyo.
lines.style: Informative dad mode, patient and explanatory, calm pacing throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 水族館！お土産屋さんでぬいぐるみ買ってもいい？市販のお菓子もちょっとだけ欲しい！
lines.en: An aquarium! Can I buy a plushie at the gift shop? I want some store-bought snacks too, just a little!
lines.style: Pleading child tone, hopeful and slightly whiny, sweet and bouncy

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 一個ずつだけならいいよ。夜はナイトクルーズも予約してあるんだ。きれいな夜景で、いいムードになるぞ。
lines.en: Just one of each is fine. I also booked a night cruise for the evening. The night view is beautiful, it'll make a great mood.
lines.style: Teasing dad warmth, playful pride about the surprise plan

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ナイトクルーズ！？ママもびっくりするね！パパ、最高！
lines.en: A night cruise!? Mom is gonna be so surprised! Dad, you're the best!
lines.style: Burst of childlike joy, loud and bouncing, pure delight

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: よし、じゃあ準備しよう。靴履いて、上着も持ってきな。
lines.en: Alright, let's get ready then. Put your shoes on and grab your jacket too.
lines.style: Practical dad cue to action, gentle but directive, affectionate
